item.title: How Ford Pro plans to help fleets run better in 2026
item.description: Ford Pro is leveraging AI and data to shift routine maintenance from when the service shop is open to whenever the vehicle is idle, promising fleets unprecedented uptime and a seamless, proactive service ecosystem.

item.title: Fontana: Why trucking leaders need to get out of the office and into industry events
item.description: Conferences and trainings give fleet leaders and staff exposure to new ideas, technologies, and honest discussions about implementation challenges.

item.title: 2026's regulatory rodeo with David Heller, Truckload Carriers Association
item.description: 2026 is shaping up to be a complex regulatory environment for trucking. The Truckload Carriers Association’s David Heller explains how some regulatory changes are not measured with a calendar but rather a stopwatch.

item.title: U.S. diesel and gas prices rise after winter storm
item.description: Fuel price averages rise after severe winter weather, affecting trucking and logistics operations.

item.title: Roeth: How finding and being a mentor can boost your trucking career
item.description: Mentorship in trucking builds skills, fosters connections, and helps both mentors and mentees achieve career growth.

item.title: Paccar enters 2026 with ‘very strong’ Class 8 truck order pace
item.description: CEO Preston Feight told analysts that added clarity on tariffs and emissions rules is helping drive demand. Body builders have been particularly active of late, he noted.

item.title: Werner buys FirstFleet to grow dedicated division
item.description: By acquiring FirstFleet, Werner Enterprises increases its dedicated revenue by 50% to nearly $1.9 billion. The combined operation brings together two top-50 FleetOwner 500 for-hire carriers.

item.title: EV battery degradation 101
item.description: Battery health in EVs declines approximately 2.3% annually, with fast charging and high temperatures accelerating degradation. Fleet managers are advised to balance charging needs, avoid extreme SOC, and monitor vehicle usage to ensure long-term battery performance.

item.title: Dry van and reefer spot rates dip, but winter storms could push prices higher
item.description: Freight rates cooled across most equipment types last week, but weather disruptions may soon test that downward momentum.

item.title: Explore250: The ultimate road trip app celebrating America’s 250th anniversary
item.description: The Explore250 app helps drivers discover America’s rich history and natural beauty by providing detailed information on destinations from coast to coast. The app features themes, digital collectibles, and recommendations, turning routine routes into memorable journeys celebrating the nation’s 250th birthday.
